period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account, read from National Bank's own half-yearly Q2-2020 unaudited financial statements (clean digital text with scattered character-level corruption). TOTAL ASSETS (476,230,212,176), TOTAL LIABILITIES (426,096,537,978) and TOTAL DEPOSITS (371,295,236,653) are all cleanly printed for the current period; comparative (31 Dec 2019) figures for deposits, gross_loans and investments_securities all match this dataset's existing FY2019 figures exactly. TOTAL SHAREHOLDERS' EQUITY's own printed cell is a garbled fragment consistent with, but not identical to, Total Assets minus Total Liabilities (50,133,674,198); the identity-derived figure is used and cross-checks against NAV per share (50,133.67m / 2,920,398,704 shares = 17.16, matching the filing's own printed NAV of ~17.17 once its leading-digit OCR noise is corrected). IMPORTANT CORRECTION DURING CROSS-VALIDATION: this filing's own printed cumulative (Jan-Jun 2020) net_interest_income cell is missing its leading digit(s) in the raw text ('  ,405,177,221'); read at face value this would give 1,405,177,221, which was the initial reading, but cross-referencing 2021_Q2.json's own Jan-Jun-2020 comparative column shows this figure cleanly as 1,805,177,221 -- and using 1,805,177,221 makes Total Operating Income (5,237,641,957), Profit Before Provision (2,018,095,709), Profit Before Tax (1,518,095,709, which matches this filing's own directly-printed 'r,518,095,709' fragment exactly) and PAT (1,018,095,709) all reconcile exactly against both this filing's own printed totals and 2021_Q2.json's comparative column -- so 1,805,177,221 (not 1,405,177,221) is used here as the correct value. Tax (500,000,000) is derived as Profit Before Tax minus PAT, a clean round number confirming the correction. interest_income and interest_expense are not legible in this filing's own P&L (that row is corrupted across all four columns) and were recovered from 2021_Q2.json's own Jan-Jun-2020 comparative column (15,999,274,337 and 14,194,097,116 respectively; their difference reproduces the corrected net_interest_income exactly). EPS is the filing's own printed cumulative figure; note it implies a higher share count than Dec-2019's paid-up capital would suggest, consistent with this dataset's documented 'Re-stated EPS' phenomenon (retroactive bonus-share adjustment) seen elsewhere in this series -- the printed figure is kept rather than a naive recomputation.
